reason: My regulars and Google reviews already keep the counter busy, and I've never paid a creator, so a free tool to find them doesn't solve a problem I have. I'm not going to start a creator budget just because the tracking is free.
objection: Customers won't bother showing a coupon on their phone during a rush, and my counter staff won't stop to tap a PIN, so the numbers will undercount and I'll think the creator did nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Another darshini owner near me showing me their redeemed-coupon sheet matched to their bill book, with real new customers from one barter post.
